settings.akici_60_fps_ve_temiz_metin_pil: Smooth 60 FPS and clean text; battery and heat stay reasonable.
settings.android_de_bildirimlerdeki_yani: On Android, the “Reply” action in notifications carries a PendingIntent and RemoteInput in the background. To block fake message injection, SystemServer only trusts this action for a NotificationListenerService APK that the user has approved on the Notification Access screen.
settings.android_e_iletilen_mantiksal_ca: Set the logical workspace (dp) passed to Android: tablet, desktop or wide layout.

settings.arayuzun_genel_temasini_secin_a: Choose the overall theme of the interface: light or dark.
settings.arka_planda_gizlice_sanal_pence: Secretly opening a virtual window in the background and pasting text blindly from the clipboard is unreliable. In OpenDeX, when you click a notification the WhatsApp window simply comes into focus on the desktop; you send your message safely with your keyboard, mouse and chat history.
settings.ayarlariniz_dengeli_gorunuyor_e: Your settings look balanced; we have no further suggestions.
settings.ayni_anda_canli_video_yayini_ya: The maximum number of windows that can stream live video at the same time.
settings.baglanan_cihazlar_kayitli_cihaz: Devices you connect are added to the Saved Devices list and reconnect with one click.
settings.bildirim_triyaji_kartlardaki_ok: Notification triage: “Mark as read” (double check) on the cards doesn't delete the notification; it hides it from the “Unread” tab and keeps it in history (“All”). Notifications are permanently deleted from the system only when you press the “X” button.
settings.bildirimlerden_dogrudan_yanit_n: Why can't I reply directly from notifications?
settings.bir_uygulama_dpi_degisimini_yas: If an app has gone through a DPI change (moving from phone to window, live DPI, returning to the phone), this forces it to rebuild its interface at the new density (for apps like YouTube that keep their interface at the old density). The app doesn't close: its activities are rebuilt in the same process with their state preserved. If turned off, nothing is refreshed.
settings.boyut_ve_dpi_degisimi_telefonda: Size and DPI changes happen behind the PC window's curtain, not on the phone.
settings.boyutlandirmada_dpi_i_sabit_tut: Keeps DPI fixed while resizing (zero freeze).
settings.bu_secim_yalniz_telefona_aktar: This choice is only the default for the “Send to phone” button. To change it once, right-click the window title; apps you open yourself on the phone always open full screen.
settings.bu_yalnizca_yeni_bir_pencere_ne: This is only the default for “where a new window starts”; it can be changed by hand from each window's title (a specific setting overrides the general one).
settings.cihaz_kapasitesine_gore_otomati: Chooses automatically based on the device's capacity.
settings.cihazin_ayni_anda_kac_pencere: Measures on the real device how many windows it can stream at once.
settings.cihazin_donanimina_gore_en_iyi: Picks the best encoder for the device's hardware (H.265 preferred).
settings.cihazin_test_edilmis_donanim_si: Uses the device's tested hardware limit.
settings.cozunurluk_pencerenin_video_ala: Resolution is calculated pixel-for-pixel from the window's video area (minus the title bar and borders). Content density (DPI) is balanced within the 180–220 band, so text doesn't shrink to a tiny size and the multi-column layout is kept in full screen.
settings.daha_keskin_goruntu_boyut_degis: Sharper image; there may be a brief freeze when resizing. Can be kept off on weaker devices.
settings.daha_keskin_metin_daha_az_renk: Sharper text, less color bleeding, high quality at the same bit rate.
settings.deneysel_ekrandaki_metin_ve_but: Experimental: mirrors the text and button coordinates on screen as a transparent DOM layer.
settings.derin_gece_tonlari_ve_cam_efekt: Deep night tones and a glass effect; easy on the eyes.
settings.dikey_alani_yuksek_tek_ekranda_: Tall vertical space: more text, code and web content on a single screen.
settings.dinamik_fix_acikken_stream_oran: With Dynamic-Fix on, the stream ratio already matches the window exactly, so the three modes give practically the same result; the difference only shows with fixed-resolution strategies.
settings.dinamik_fix_stream_orani_pencer: Dynamic-Fix: the stream ratio is matched exactly to the window's video area and the resolution is aligned to a multiple of 8 that the encoder supports; no stretching, black bars or downscaling.
settings.dpi_degisen_uygulamanin_arayuzu: Rebuilds the interface of an app whose DPI changed at the new density, keeping its state.
settings.dpi_degisince_uygulamalarin_sur: When DPI changes, the apps' processes are restarted; background services such as playing music are cut off.
settings.dpi_sonrasi_uygulamayi_yenile: Refresh the app after a DPI change
settings.dusuk_bant_genisligi_kullanan: A compressed audio stream that uses low bandwidth.
